svg.title: Mitra - classifier
svg.desc: AutoGluon - one stack, attending across rows and across features · 75.7 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; S: support rows; Q: query rows; F: features; D: model width (512). Abbreviations: MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: × N: the block is stacked N times; the card is drawn once, as a deck; card colour: what kind of stage it is (see the legend above); right margin: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count; left margin: the phase each group of stages belongs to.
svg.text: AutoGluon - one stack, attending across rows and across features · 75.7 M parameters
numeric matrix; the preprocessor mean-imputes first
999 quantiles of the support column; query values bucketed against them; no weights
a learned vector per class, plus one "unknown" for the query rows; prepended as fea...
pre-norm; 4 heads of 128; two attentions, two MLPs of 512 -> 2048
10 slots; softmax over the classes seen
keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads)
× N: the block is stacked N times; the card is drawn once, as a deck
card colour: what kind of stage it is (see the legend above)
right margin: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count
left margin: the phase each group of stages belongs to
